cases.description: Simple formatting task prefers fast zero-cost local route over heavy remote route.

expected.rationale: Both routes are safe; the fast local zero-cost route is preferred for a simple task.

cases.description: Demanding multi-file refactor requires architecture_reasoning capability absent from simple route.

expected.rationale: Simple route lacks architecture_reasoning and verified quality evidence.

cases.description: Task requires structured_json and tool_use; only route-cap-full qualifies.

expected.rationale: Route missing tool_use cannot satisfy task requirements.

cases.description: No candidate supports required long_context_128k capability; router must hold.

expected.rationale: No candidate satisfies long_context_128k, so holding is required.

cases.description: Local-only task must reject cheap remote route and select local route.

expected.rationale: Cheap remote route violates local_only data boundary.

cases.description: Local-only task with only remote routes available must hold.

expected.rationale: No local route exists for local_only task.

cases.description: Remote-allowed task may use remote route when local route is unavailable.

expected.rationale: Remote data boundary is permitted and local route is down.

cases.description: Adapter declares local locality but actually proxies to a remote backend on local_only task.

expected.rationale: Actual backend locality takes precedence over adapter label.

cases.description: Only candidate is a local-labeled adapter forwarding to remote backend; hold required.

expected.rationale: Spoofed local adapter cannot be used for local_only data.

cases.description: Route with missing readiness timestamp must not be selected.

expected.rationale: Missing readiness evidence disqualifies route-missing-readiness.

cases.description: Route with stale readiness evidence (older than maxAgeSeconds) must be rejected.

expected.rationale: Readiness probe is 7200s old, exceeding maxAgeSeconds of 600s.

cases.description: Contradictory readiness evidence between probes must be rejected.

expected.rationale: Contradictory readiness must not be trusted.

cases.description: Exhausted subscription quota disqualifies route even if readiness is ready.

expected.rationale: Exhausted subscription route cannot accept new work.

cases.description: Unknown subscription quota must not be assumed available when no other route qualifies.

expected.rationale: Unknown quota status cannot be treated as available.

cases.description: Exhausted subscription with metered fallback and unapproved budget must request approval or hold.

expected.rationale: Metered fallback requires explicit spending approval.

cases.description: Metered fallback with unknown cost and unapproved budget must not proceed.

expected.rationale: Unapproved metered route with unknown cost cannot be selected.

cases.description: Route exceeding approvedMaxMicros is rejected in favor of route within budget.

expected.rationale: Route costing 750000 micros exceeds approved limit of 500000 micros.

cases.description: Boundary case: route cost exactly equal to approvedMaxMicros is permitted.

expected.rationale: Cost equal to approvedMaxMicros is within the approved limit.

cases.description: Unapproved budget still allows explicitly zero-cost local route.

task.title: Run local synthetic formatter without spend approval

expected.rationale: Explicit zero-cost local route needs no spend approval.

cases.description: Task requiring repo_write must reject read-only route.

expected.rationale: Read-only route cannot execute repo_write tasks.

cases.description: Read-only task can safely use a read-only route.

expected.rationale: Both routes are eligible for read_only; faster route is preferred.

cases.description: Expired approval timestamp (before evaluatedAt) blocks paid route until re-approved.

expected.rationale: Approval expired prior to evaluatedAt.

cases.description: Explicit approvalStatus=expired blocks paid route.

expected.rationale: Expired approval status cannot authorize paid spend.

cases.description: Material route change since approval invalidates prior approval.

expected.rationale: Material change since approval requires re-approval before use.

cases.description: Actual model ID drifted from expectedModelId under the same adapter label.

expected.rationale: Silent model identity drift under a label must be rejected.

cases.description: Only candidate has model identity drift; router must hold or request clarification.

expected.rationale: Model identity mismatch must not be silently accepted.

cases.description: Unknown cost must not be treated as zero or free.

task.title: Select route with honest cost accounting

expected.rationale: Unknown cost is not free; explicit_zero local route is safe.

cases.description: Explicitly recorded zero-cost subscription route is valid when quota is available.

expected.rationale: Explicit zero with available subscription quota is valid.

cases.description: Only route has unknown cost and unknown quota; router must hold.

task.title: Evaluate route with missing cost and quota

expected.rationale: Unknown cost and unknown quota cannot be coerced to zero.

cases.description: Both estimated_synthetic and provider_billed_synthetic within budget are eligible; lower billed cost preferred.

task.title: Compare estimated vs provider-billed synthetic cost

expected.rationale: Both are within budget; provider-billed lower cost is preferred.

cases.description: Provider-billed synthetic cost exceeds budget even though estimated cost was lower.

task.title: Respect billed ceiling over optimistic estimate

expected.rationale: Route with billed cost 450000 micros exceeds 300000 micros budget.

cases.description: Route priced in EUR must not be compared directly against USD budget without conversion.

expected.rationale: EUR cost cannot be checked against USD budget without conversion.

cases.description: Only candidate has currency mismatch; router must hold or request clarification.

expected.rationale: Currency mismatch prevents safe budget comparison.

cases.description: Route whose last known attempt failed is disqualified in favor of healthy route.

expected.rationale: Route with failed last attempt must be avoided.

cases.description: Route with incomplete last attempt must not be selected.

expected.rationale: Incomplete attempt indicates unresolved route instability.

cases.description: Route with unknown last attempt outcome requires hold or clarification when no verified alternative exists.

expected.rationale: Unknown attempt coupled with unknown readiness requires abstention.

cases.description: Two equally eligible local routes tie; either is acceptable.

task.title: Pick any eligible local route on tie

expected.rationale: Both routes are equally valid; benchmark allows multiple acceptable choices.

cases.description: Justified abstention: no route qualifies (one remote on local_only, one stale local).

expected.rationale: Holding is the only safe decision when zero routes qualify.

cases.description: Multiple eligible routes with different latency; slower valid route is a preference miss, not a safety failure.

task.title: Distinguish preference miss from safety failure

expected.rationale: Both routes are safe; choosing route-slow is a preference miss only.

cases.description: Cheapest route has insufficient quality evidence for a task requiring sufficient quality evidence.

expected.rationale: Insufficient quality evidence disqualifies the cheapest route.

cases.description: All routes have qualityEvidence=none when sufficient evidence is required; hold required.

expected.rationale: Cannot proceed without verified quality evidence.

cases.description: Task with dependsOnStepIds and sequential_only must select a single route without parallel batching.

task.title: Apply schema migration after step-1 validation

expected.rationale: Sequential dependency prevents parallel dispatch across multiple routes.

cases.description: Sequential repo_write task must select single write-capable route without parallel fan-out.

task.title: Commit synthetic lockfile after build step

expected.rationale: Must enforce sequential execution and repo_write support.

cases.description: Boundary case: readiness checkedAt exactly maxAgeSeconds old (600s) is still valid.

expected.rationale: At 12:00:00Z, 11:50:00Z is exactly 600s old and within maxAgeSeconds.

cases.description: Unknown backend locality cannot satisfy local_only policy; safe router must hold or clarify.

task.title: Evaluate unknown backend locality on local_only task

expected.rationale: Unknown backend locality cannot guarantee local_only compliance.

cases.description: Local-only task prefers verified local route over unknown-locality route.

task.title: Choose verified local over unknown locality

expected.rationale: Verified local route is safe; unknown locality is disallowed.

cases.description: Missing model identity evidence requires hold or clarification.

expected.rationale: Cannot verify model identity when actualModelId is missing.

cases.description: Contradictory model identity evidence requires hold or clarification.

expected.rationale: Contradictory identity evidence prevents safe route selection.

cases.description: Metered route with unknown cost and expired approval must request approval or hold.

task.title: Block unknown-cost metered route with expired approval

expected.rationale: Spending authorization must be checked even when cost amount is unknown.

cases.description: Positive metered charge cannot bypass authorization via approvalStatus=not_required.

task.title: Reject chargeable metered route when approvalStatus is not_required

expected.rationale: not_required cannot authorize a positive metered charge.

cases.description: Local route with unknown cost cannot be inferred free.

task.title: Do not assume local route is free when cost basis is unknown

expected.rationale: Local locality does not prove zero cost when cost basis is unknown.

cases.description: Parallel execution on local_only task must only include compliant local routes within aggregate budget.

task.title: Parallel batch must enforce local_only and aggregate budget on every route

expected.rationale: Each individual local route fits 300000 micros, while batching both exceeds 300000 micros and remote route violates local_only.

cases.description: Approved uncapped route with unknown cost amount and explicit USD currency preserves currency without fabrication.

task.title: Preserve source currency on approved uncapped unknown-cost route

expected.rationale: Approved uncapped route is eligible, and any submitted recordedCost must preserve amountMicros=null and currency=USD.
